requirements.name: Agent as first-class governed actor
requirements.what: Agent = identity + role + skills + memory + context + tools + policies + objectives + authority + evaluation; registered agent identity survives worker process termination; autonomy_level, risk_class, budget, supervisor, lifecycle_state, version.

requirements.name: Workflow fabric with trigger -> plan -> policy -> approval -> execute -> verify -> event
requirements.what: Workflows are structured executions with triggers, steps, policies, required authority, timeouts, retry and compensation policies; may be deterministic, AI-generated, human-authored or hybrid.

requirements.name: Action lifecycle from PROPOSED to VERIFIED
requirements.what: Action carries actor, target, operation, authority_context, risk_level, policy_decision, approval_state, execution_state, verification; lifecycle PROPOSED -> POLICY_CHECK -> APPROVAL -> EXECUTING -> VERIFYING -> COMPLETED, with REJECTED/FAILED/ROLLED_BACK/ESCALATED alternatives.

requirements.name: Evidence object and claim-evidence-observation-source graph
requirements.what: Evidence distinguishes data/knowledge/claim/hypothesis/prediction/decision; graph CLAIM -supported_by-> EVIDENCE -derived_from-> OBSERVATION -collected_from-> SOURCE; contradictions representable; evidence has identity, type, confidence, provenance.

requirements.name: AI safety boundary: thought -> proposal -> authorization -> execution
requirements.what: A model can never jump from thought to production action; full pipeline identity resolution -> tenant resolution -> context construction -> policy evaluation -> model routing -> inference -> output validation -> action proposal -> authority check -> execution -> verification -> event -> memory/knowledge update; grounding and hallucination detection on outputs.

requirements.name: Delegation, acting-on-behalf-of, and impersonation with revocation and non-escalation
requirements.what: Human/agent/service delegation with time limits, revocation, non-escalation; delegation object carries grantor, grantee, scope, expiry; authority propagation cannot exceed grantor authority; impersonation is privileged and audited.

requirements.name: Agent runtime: sessions, coordination, delegation, conflict resolution, priority, concurrency, dormancy
requirements.what: Agent execution loop with plan, action gate, action result, verification, failure recovery, compensating actions, escalation, human escalation; agent sessions, coordination, consensus, negotiation, multiplexer functions, dormancy/activation, priority queues, concurrency control, resource locks, state machine, versioning, deployment.

requirements.name: Agent sandbox, shadow mode, and rollout safety
requirements.what: Agents execute in sandboxes; shadow mode and canary rollout; agent evaluation and simulation before production; agent safety boundaries; agent supervision tree constraining autonomy.

requirements.name: Agent observability, explanation and activity graphs
requirements.what: Every agent action is observable (activity graph), explainable (agent explanation), provenance-tracked, and security-monitored; agent identity security integrates with the identity fabric.

requirements.name: Workflow/tool/action execution substrate with verification and compensation
requirements.what: Execution substrate that turns policy-approved intentions into reliable multi-step work across internal services, external systems, APIs, humans, agents, transactions, communications; idempotency keys on consequential commands; rollback and compensation paths.

requirements.name: CoreGrid autonomous company operating system (internal AI departments, CEO agent, self-operating company)
requirements.what: CoreGrid operating itself as the first autonomous organization: internal reality model, CEO intelligence agent, AI departments (engineering, research, sales, marketing, legal), internal sandbox civilization, autonomous improvement loops, internal command center.
requirements.extractOnly: Related to Jarvis; EXTRACT, do not implement engines. G-057 carries the structurally necessary V1 share.

requirements.name: Mission and objective representation for delegated work
requirements.what: Goals/objectives and constraints are representable objects bound to agents, workflows and policies; delegated work carries an objective, constraints and success criteria the verification stage can measure.

requirements.name: Outcome measurement and learning without rewriting truth
requirements.what: Executed actions produce measured outcomes; operational memory records them; learning improves future operation without silently rewriting truth or governance; knowledge changes propagate impact to affected decisions.

requirements.name: Reality loop as the platform invariant
requirements.what: The closed loop reality -> observation/events -> knowledge -> intelligence -> agents -> workflows -> experience -> action -> new reality, with governance, identity, security, memory, context, observability surrounding the entire structure; every stage grounded in evidence, governed by policy, verified afterward.
